items.prompt: Why not use zero as the only failure signal for this sum?

options.text: Zero is also a valid successful total
options.why: A typed error alternative preserves the distinction.

options.text: The empty sequence cannot have a total
options.why: Under the declared model its total is valid0.

options.text: All numeric failures are automatically exceptions
options.why: The core helper uses an explicit result policy.

options.text: A variant always contains every alternative simultaneously
options.why: It selects one alternative, subject to its general state rules.

items.explanation: Empty/zero inputs can succeed with zero, so collapsing every error to zero hides failures.
